净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Simplification of parent: removed the signed square root transformation on the contraction term and added a clip to [-1,1] to bound extreme values. This preserves the core trend-contraction interaction while reducing unnecessary nonlinearity, potentially improving rank stability and interpretability. Keeps cross_sectional_transform as none to maintain raw payoff mechanism.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

ewm_mean(10, daily_ret) * clip(1 - ATR5/ATR20, -1, 1)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

ewm_mean(10, daily_ret) * clip(1 - ATR5/ATR20, -1, 1)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ewm_mean(daily_ret) → 窗口 10 的EMA 指数移动平均
  2. 步骤2：divide(ATR5, ATR20) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  3. 步骤3：subtract(1, v2(divide)) → 减法：x - y
  4. 步骤4：neg(1) → 返回-x
  5. 步骤5：clip(v3(subtract), v4(neg), 1) → 裁剪到 [lo, hi] 区间
  6. 步骤6：multiply(v1(ewm_mean), v5(clip)) → 乘法：x × y

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ewm_meanEMA 指数移动平均

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 daily_ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 trend：talib.EMA(daily_ret, timeperiod=10)
  3. 计算 atr5：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=5)
  4. 计算 atr20：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20)
  5. 计算 contraction：1 - atr5 / atr20
  6. 计算 contraction：np.clip(contraction, -1, 1)
  7. 计算 factor：trend * contraction
  8. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_smoothed_trend_vol_contraction_simplified(df): df_copy = df.copy() daily_ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() trend = talib.EMA(daily_ret, timeperiod=10) atr5 = talib.ATR(df_copy["str">'high'], df_copy["str">'low'], df_copy["str">'close'], timeperiod=5) atr20 = talib.ATR(df_copy["str">'high'], df_copy["str">'low'], df_copy["str">'close'], timeperiod=20) contraction = 1 - atr5 / atr20.replace(0, np.nan) contraction = np.clip(contraction, -1, 1) factor = trend * contraction factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) factor.name = "str">'factor_smoothed_trend_vol_contraction_simplified' "kw">class="kw">return factor
